mapper.sql:
WHERE o.status = 'IDENTIFIED'
AND o.original_name LIKE
'%' || #{originalName} || '%'
CONCAT(CONCAT('%', #{originalName}), '%')
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_transfer_delivery_record dr WHERE dr.transfer_id = o.transfer_id AND dr.execute_status = 'SUCCESS' ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_transfer_object_tag valuation_tag WHERE valuation_tag.transfer_id = o.transfer_id AND valuation_tag.tag_code = 'VALUATION_TABLE' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_transfer_object_tag product_tag WHERE product_tag.transfer_id = o.transfer_id AND product_tag.tag_code = 'PRODUCT_MATCH_RULE' )

SELECT o.transfer_id AS transferId, o.original_name AS originalName, o.source_type AS sourceType, o.source_code AS sourceCode, o.status AS status, o.received_at AS received_at, ( SELECT MAX(valuation_tag.tag_name) FROM t_transfer_object_tag valuation_tag WHERE valuation_tag.transfer_id = o.transfer_id AND valuation_tag.tag_code = 'VALUATION_TABLE' ) AS valuationTagName FROM t_transfer_object o

choose.otherwise: ORDER BY received_at DESC, transferId DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

mapper.sql:
WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( UPPER(COALESCE(p.pd_nm, '')) LIKE
'%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
CONCAT(CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{keyword})), '%')
OR UPPER(COALESCE(p.pd_cd, '')) LIKE
'%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
CONCAT(CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{keyword})), '%')
OR UPPER(COALESCE(p.manage_org_cd, '')) LIKE
'%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
CONCAT(CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{keyword})), '%')
)

SELECT DISTINCT p.pd_cd AS productCode, p.pd_nm AS productName, p.manage_org_cd AS managerCode, COALESCE(s.source_name, p.manage_org_cd) AS managerName FROM TM_SPV_PF_BSC_INFO p LEFT JOIN t_transfer_source s ON s.source_code = p.manage_org_cd

choose.otherwise: ORDER BY productName ASC, productCode ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
